name: newapi-admin
description: Full-surface administrator tooling for a New API (new-api) instance: channels, model metadata, model pricing and ratios, users, tokens, redemption codes, logs, statistics, groups, vendors and root system options. Ships a zero-dependency CLI plus an MCP server that reaches every management route, with an authoritative field-level reference distilled from the New API router and source.

base_url.description: New API instance URL, for example https://api.example.com. No trailing slash needed. Also settable via the NEWAPI_BASE_URL environment variable.

access_token.description: Admin or root access token. Create it in the New API panel under Personal settings -> Account -> Security -> system access token. Root is required for pricing, system options and system tasks; a plain admin also lacks channel:sensitive_write, so it cannot add or delete channels. Also settable via NEWAPI_ACCESS_TOKEN.

user_id.description: Optional. Sent as the deprecated New-Api-User header. Current builds ignore it; set it only for an older instance or an authenticating proxy that still expects it.

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow instances or when testing channels.
